title: SRMIST to Host National Conference on Translational Regenerative Biology and Bioengineering (TRBB 2026) in Chennai
summary: SRMIST's Division of Medical Research will host TRBB 2026, a national conference on regenerative biology and bioengineering, in Chennai from 3 to 5 November 2026.
body_html:
Chennai, 2 November 2026: The Division of Medical Research at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) will host the National Conference on Translational Regenerative Biology and Bioengineering (TRBB 2026) from 3 to 5 November 2026. A pre-conference workshop on 3 November will be followed by the main conference on 4 and 5 November.

The conference will bring together scientists, clinicians, academicians, industry professionals and students to share knowledge and discuss emerging developments in biomedical science and healthcare innovation in regenerative biology. According to the organisers, it seeks to highlight the growing significance of regenerative biology and bioengineering at a time when medical research is increasingly focused on turning scientific advances into practical healthcare solutions.

The scientific programme will cover stem cell biology, sub cellular therapy, lab-on-a-chip technologies, organoids, biomaterials and theranostics. The organisers said the aim is to encourage interdisciplinary collaboration and strengthen the link between fundamental research and its potential clinical applications, including new approaches to diagnosis and treatment through tissue regeneration and novel biomaterials.

TRBB 2026 will include keynote lectures, invited talks, workshops, poster presentations and flash talks by scientists from institutions across India. A science communication session for the public is also planned, intended to raise awareness of regenerative medicine, address apprehensions about novel therapies and explain the limitations of these technologies. The event is expected to benefit doctoral scholars and early-career researchers in particular, as well as undergraduate and postgraduate students of life sciences, medicine and bioengineering.

The Organising Secretaries of TRBB 2026, Dr. Snehasis Mishra, Dr. Rizwanul Haque, Dr. Shiny PJ, Dr. Muralidhara Rao, Dr. Gisha Sivan and Dr. Sourav Banerjee, said the conference will bring together approximately 200 delegates from across India, while the pre-conference workshop has 79 registered participants.

Keynote addresses will be delivered by Prof. Suman Chakraborty of IIT Kharagpur and Prof. Sarit Kumar Das of IIT Madras. Scientific lectures will be given by Prof. Vignesh Muthuvijayan, Prof. Asim Bhaumik, Prof. Santanu Dhara, Dr. Greeshma Thrivikraman, Dr. Saumya Ray Chaudhuri, Dr. S. Balakumar, Dr. Amlan Das, Dr. A. Joseph Nathanael, Dr. Krishnanda Chattopadhyay and Dr. R. Ilangovan, representing institutions including IIT Madras, the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science (IACS), IMTECH Chandigarh, the University of Madras and VIT.

According to Prof. Sunil Narayan, Dean, Medical Research, SRMIST, TRBB 2026 aims to lay the foundations for starting a regenerative medicine programme at the department of medical research, in collaboration with the university's bioengineering and clinical departments, and to contribute to the advancement of regenerative biology and bioengineering research in India and the translation of scientific discoveries into future healthcare solutions.
